in_hebrew.name: גאלנוס
in_hebrew.meaning: גאלנוס נגזר מהמילה היוונית גאלן שמשמעותו רגוע, שקט
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם גאלנוס מקורו במילה היוונית גאלן (Galēnos), שפירושה רגוע או שקט. שם זה שימש כנראה כהתייחסות לאדם עם אופי רגוע או שקט. אין אזכור לשם זה בכתבי הקודש העבריים, אך הוא עשוי להיות קשור למושגים של רוגע ושלווה הנמצאים בכתבי הקודש.

in_greek.name: Γαληνός
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο Γαληνός προέρχεται από την ελληνική λέξη Γαλήνη (Galēnē), που σημαίνει ήρεμος ή γαλήνιος. Αυτό το όνομα πιθανότατα δόθηκε σε άτομα με ήρεμο χαρακτήρα. Ο Γαληνός ήταν επίσης ονομαστός γιατρός και φιλόσοφος της αρχαιότητας, γνωστός για τις συνεισφορές του στην ιατρική και τη φιλοσοφία.

in_latin.name: Galenus
in_latin.meaning: Galenus means calm, serene, or peaceful
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Galenus is derived from the Greek word Galenos (Γαληνός), meaning calm or serene. This name was likely given to individuals with a peaceful demeanor. Galenus, or Galen, was a prominent physician, surgeon, and philosopher in the Roman Empire, renowned for his medical treatises and philosophical works.

in_english.name: Galenus
in_english.long_meaning: The name Galenus originates from the Greek name Γαληνός (Galēnos), meaning calm, serene, or peaceful. This name likely signified an individual with a tranquil and composed personality. Galenus, as known in English, refers to the famous 2nd-century physician and philosopher Galen, whose works significantly influenced medicine and philosophy. The name carries connotations of wisdom, calmness, and intellectual prowess.

data.cultural_impact: Saint Galenus, also known as Galen in the Western world, was a prominent physician and philosopher in the Roman Empire. His contributions to medicine and the development of the scientific method continue to influence modern medical practices. As a Christian saint, Galenus is regarded as the patron of physicians, medical students, and surgeons. He is also revered in various locales for his charitable works towards the sick and the poor.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Christian faith, Saint Galenus represents the selfless act of healing in the name of God. He embodies the biblical quote, "love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind" (Matthew 22:37 NIV). By providing medical care and comfort to those in need, Galenus went above and beyond the call of duty, offering spiritual solace as well as physical healing. Furthermore, he serves as a reminder of God's healing power and unending compassion towards His children, inspiring generations of believers to follow in his footsteps.
